description: Use this only when the user explicitly asks for new or different jobs (neue Stellen) than the ones already matched. Replaces the current matches with up to five jobs never matched to this user before and says how many; call get_job_matches to show them. Once every 24 hours; an earlier call is refused with zu_frueh and names the time from which it works. Scope: cv:schreiben.
name: refresh_job_matches
title: Get five new job matches
